method: Every named whole PNG was inspected through view_image at original resolution. No crop, alignment, image measurement, or geometry inference. AX and command receipts confirm runtime state and actual drags.
findings: The corrected granite insert ends fit the wooden lower seat in upright front, left and right oblique/side frames, without conspicuous wood penetration or red highlight bleed.
Inverted wood-flat front and both side views retain a separate dark speckled granite insert above the cavity while the wooden bearing rim alone is red.
All eight active selections render the intended contact and selected specification; visible unselected materials retain their normal wood/granite finish.
A physical legend tap changes granite to wood in the same live detail instance. Granite returns to its speckled finish and remains restored after an actual orbit.
Nine real drag gestures preserve the selected AX contact and change projected contact frames. All final frames show the complete board and cord.
The unselected Train card and granite relaunch retain the correct material separation.
nonBlockingObservations: Telephoto front frames expose fine tube-segment edge aliasing at the cord bends; the granite seam remains unobscured.
One inverted right-front frame includes the transient system Dynamic Island mask at the top of the screenshot; the complete board and seat remain visible.
limits: These runtime frames are visual evidence of the exported asset, not a quantitative native-solid intersection proof. Root native and exported-triangle audits cover that separately.
Normal appearance is reviewed only where a contact is actually unselected; detail has no clear-selection action.
Focused board review only; no workout, audio, HealthKit or landscape claim. Human acceptance remains pending.
